blurb: Guests receive various types of massage therapy tailored to their needs, including Swedish massage for relaxation and circulation, neuromuscular therapy for chronic pain, sports massage for athletes, lymphatic massage for detoxification, craniosacral therapy for nervous system support, oncology massage for cancer patients, and other specialized techniques. Sessions use oils, creams, or lotions and apply different pressures and strokes depending on the therapy.
